properties.name: consent.based.authorization.enabled
properties.description: Whether ConsentAuthorizationService scopes auth-backend queries to the caller's current dbGaP consents and re-checks saved results against them before returning them. Maps from the CONSENT_BASED_AUTHORIZATION_ENABLED environment variable. When false, both checks are skipped for every backend.

properties.name: hpds.rs.url
properties.description: Base URL of the Rust HPDS backend, for example http://hpds-rs:8080/PIC-SURE; the HPDS API path is appended to it as for the Java backends. Maps from HPDS_RS_URL. Unset or blank turns Rust routing off whatever hpds.rs.mode says.

properties.name: hpds.rs.token
properties.description: Service Bearer token sent to Rust HPDS on sync query calls; search calls carry none, as on Java. Maps from HPDS_RS_TOKEN. Secret.

properties.name: hpds.rs.mode
properties.description: How the Rust HPDS backend is used. off: Java answers everything. shadow: Java answers and a sample of eligible calls is mirrored to Rust and compared, logging only statuses, latencies, match or mismatch and the normalization name. serve: Rust answers eligible calls and any Rust connect error, timeout or non-2xx answer falls back to Java for that call. Maps from HPDS_RS_MODE; read once at startup, so setting it to off takes a restart.

properties.name: hpds.rs.types
properties.description: Result types routed or mirrored to Rust HPDS, comma separated. SEARCH and SEARCH_VALUES name the concept search and genomic values calls; genomic result types are added by name. Only auth-backend sync queries and search calls are eligible, so async types never reach Rust. An unknown name stops startup. Maps from HPDS_RS_TYPES.

properties.name: hpds.rs.shadow-sample
properties.description: Share of eligible calls mirrored to Rust HPDS in shadow mode, from 0 to 1. Maps from HPDS_RS_SHADOW_SAMPLE.

properties.name: hpds.rs.shadow-max-in-flight
properties.description: Most mirrored Rust HPDS calls in flight at once in shadow mode. A sampled call over the limit is dropped and counted in hpds.rs.shadow.dropped, never queued. Maps from HPDS_RS_SHADOW_MAX_IN_FLIGHT.

properties.name: hpds.rs.timeout-ms
properties.description: Read timeout of Rust HPDS calls in milliseconds. A serve-mode call that times out falls back to Java. Maps from HPDS_RS_TIMEOUT_MS.
